definitions.explanation: The same complaints or grievances expressed over and over again. Often tiresome or annoying to listeners.

examples.japanese: また{同|おな}じ{繰|く}り{言|ごと}か。
examples.english: The same old complaints again, huh?

examples.japanese: {繰|く}り{言|ごと}を{言|い}っても{何|なに}も{変|か}わらない。
{祖母|そぼ}はいつも{昔|むかし}の{繰|く}り{言|ごと}ばかりだ。
examples.english: My grandmother is always repeating the same old stories/complaints about the past.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{繰|く}り (repeating, from {繰|く}り{返|かえ}す) + {言|ごと/こと} (words)
Literally: "repeated words"

USAGE:
{繰|く}り{言|ごと} implies the complaints are tedious because they've been heard many times before. Often used with a tone of exasperation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{繰|く}り{言|ごと}を{言|い}う - to complain repeatedly
・{繰|く}り{言|ごと}ばかり - nothing but repetitive complaints
・{同|おな}じ{繰|く}り{言|ごと} - the same old complaints

RELATED 〜{言|ごと} WORDS:
・{愚痴|ぐち} - complaints, grumbling (general)
・{泣|な}き{言|ごと} - whining, complaining
・{寝言|ねごと} - sleep-talking; nonsense

REGISTER:
Casual to neutral. Often used with mild exasperation.
